metadata.name: Allen Human Reference Atlas – 3D, 2020
metadata.credit: © 2019 Allen Institute for Brain Science. Ding, S.-L. et al. (2020), RRID:SCR_017764.
metadata.derivation: Spatial vertex clustering of the existing measured atlas. Each cluster retains the nearest original vertex; source triangles and cortical face labels are remapped. No invented structure geometry. Uniform projection only; relative anatomical coordinates are preserved.
metadata.limitations: Simplified reference surfaces, not an individual brain. Nearest-label lobe boundaries are approximate. Highlighted basal ganglia show the caudate, putamen and globus pallidus, not the entire functional circuit. Plane markers show anatomical orientation, not diagnostic imaging.

encoding.positions: base64 little-endian int16 xyz / 100 mm; x right, y superior, z anterior
encoding.faceRegions: base64 uint8 region index per triangle
